md: - **HDI trend 1990-2017:** India's HDI rose **0.427 → 0.640**, nearly **50%** (HDR 2018 update, rank **130th**); ⚠ APPSC key (2019) gave **40%**.
- **HCI components:** **survival** (under-5 mortality), expected **quality-adjusted years of schooling**, and **health** (adult survival, child stunting).
- **2014-15:** real GDP growth about **7.3%** – first estimate on the new **2011-12 series** (2015).
- **PCI 2017-18:** per capita income at **current prices** rose about **8.6%** over 2016-17 (CSO provisional estimates).

md: - **Mining share:** mining and quarrying ≈ **3%** of GVA (2016-17, 2011-12 base) – small output share, key raw-material supplier.
- **Output = income:** production pays factor incomes, so national product equals national income; **J.R. Hicks** (*The Social Framework*): **Net Social Product = Social Income**.
- **Architect:** **P.C. Mahalanobis** designed independent India's statistical system – founded **ISI (1931)** and the **NSS (1950)**.
- **MDG 1 result:** India **met** the halving-extreme-poverty target by 2015; it **missed** maternal health, hunger and sanitation targets.
- **Health MDGs:** **three** of eight – MDG 4 child mortality, MDG 5 maternal health, MDG 6 HIV/malaria; merged into **SDG 3**.
- **Mission LiFE** (Lifestyle for Environment, 2021): targets **individual demand**, **industry supply** and **policy** to change consumption and production behaviour.
- **2018 edition:** framed on the **17 SDGs** (only 13 goals scored, data gaps); Kerala and HP front runners (69), **Tamil Nadu 3rd**.
- **PMKSY planning:** **District Irrigation Plans** feed **State Irrigation Plans**; State Level Sanctioning Committee chaired by the **Chief Secretary**.
- **PM-DevINE** (Budget 2022-23): central sector scheme under **DoNER** for the North-East; infrastructure in **Gati Shakti** spirit + livelihoods; **not a substitute** for existing schemes.
